bio.text: Keith Powers represents District 74 in the New York State Assembly, according to the Assembly's member directory.
His official biography says he was born and raised in Stuyvesant Town and Peter Cooper Village in Manhattan, where he still lives, and that he has served the East Side of Manhattan since 2018.
According to that biography, he attended the CUNY Graduate Center and the University of Dayton.
